rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift, unless specifically made irrevocable and for past services, is revocable if the donee fails to fulfill the conditions attached to the gift.
rules.supporting_quote: Where, on the other hand, the donee has failed to carry out the conditions on which the gift was made, he cannot invoke the protection of the renunciation clause, which was intended to take affect only if the stipulations in the deed were complied with.
